review_notes: I read the whole file. I looked for a Mathlib concept that the file re-defines. The only `def` is `polynomialQuotientBaseChange`. It is a base-change equivalence K ⊗[R] (MvPolynomial n R ⧸ I) ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial n K ⧸ I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R K)). The proof is built from Mathlib's `tensorQuotientEquiv` and `MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv`. A grep of Mathlib found no existing declaration with this statement. The only nearby hits were in NoetherNormalization, which is a different statement. So this is a named composition of existing operations, not a competing concept. The file's other declarations are theorems, which the rubric excludes. I also grepped Mathlib/FieldTheory for field embeddings over a countable base into an uncountable algebraically closed field. I found nothing equivalent. The two near-identical integral-equation proofs in the file duplicate theorems, not concepts, so I did not report them. I did not exhaustively search every Mathlib directory, so some uncertainty remains.
